name: Korabl'-Sputnik
about: Korabl'-Sputnik (1960 EPS 3), a crewed vehicle (Vostok1), launched 1960 May 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (R).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1960 Jun 20), held fixed
GCAT marks this date uncertain or gives it without an hour
